subject: Interested in technical demo — Quickstart trial (developer intent)
messages:
From: Elliot Stone <elliot.stone@buildgrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:23:00 +01:00
Subject: Quickstart trial — looking for a technical walkthrough

Hi Jonas,

I just finished the Quickstart guide on your docs and spun up a small prototype talking to the hosted API. We're evaluating Redwood for a feature in our product that needs predictable latency and a private deployment option later. I flagged developer intent in the form and wanted to request a short technical demo (30 mins) that covers:
- deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- integration points for prefix caching and SDK examples
- quantization/latency tradeoffs for 8-bit models

We're based in Copenhagen (CEST). Best windows next week are:
- Tue May 11 after 15:00 CEST
- Thu May 13 between 10:00–12:30 CEST

I've attached a tiny sample config and the repo link for context.

Thanks,
Elliot

--
Elliot Stone
Senior Platform Engineer, BuildGrid
elliot.stone@buildgrid.com
https://buildgrid.com

Hi Elliot — great to see you through the Quickstart, and thanks for the context. I'm Jonas on the SDR/solutions side; I'll coordinate a 30-minute technical walkthrough with one of our engineers.

Camila (cc) is our applied ML/solutions engineer who usually runs these sessions. Camila — Elliot is evaluating for a latency-sensitive feature and wants a quick tour of deployment options + integration patterns. He prefers CEST windows (listed below).

Elliot — can you confirm whether Thu May 13 10:30 CEST works? If so we'll send a calendar invite with an agenda. If not, we can also do Tue May 11 15:30 CEST.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min intros + goals
2) 15 min demo: runtime behavior, caching, and SDK samples
3) 5 min deployment/ops Q&A (Dedicated/private options)
4) 5 min next steps and follow-ups (SLA/POC)

Links: Calendly (for alternatives) — https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-tech-demo
Docs quickstart reference — https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart#onramp

Jonas Weber

Hi Camila/Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround. Thu May 13 at 10:30 CEST works for us. Please include a calendar invite and the agenda. I'll loop in our infra lead (Marta Ruiz) on the invite for the security piece.

Quick note on goals so you can tailor the demo:
- We're targeting p95 tail latency < 200ms for short interactive calls (<=256 tokens).
- We expect bursty traffic during peak times; curious about autoscaling and dedicated pools.
- We'll want a short POC run on Dedicated once we validate latency.

If you can include a short SSO/JIT example (just an outline), that'd be helpful. Looking forward to the demo.

Cheers,
